summary: Fix correctly resolves the reported crash by special-casing OrderBy instances in Meta.ordering, but it's narrower than needed: any other resolve_expression-bearing item (e.g. bare F() or Func()) in Meta.ordering will still hit the string-oriented recursive path and crash the same way.

issues.description: Only isinstance(item, OrderBy) is special-cased; other expression types with resolve_expression (F(), Func(), Case(), etc.) placed in Meta.ordering still fall through to find_ordering_name's string-splitting logic and will raise the same class of error, so the general expression-ordering case isn't fully fixed.

Hard-coding is_ref=False for every OrderBy item is a simplification; if such an item ever legitimately referenced an annotated alias, downstream logic that branches on is_ref would silently treat it as non-referential.
